countCursor: Click Counter: +1 on the block at cursor
uncountCursor: Click Counter: -1 on the block at cursor
diagnose: Click Counter: diagnose why the block is not countable
scanPhantom: Click Counter: check for blocks that exist only in the UI (diagnostic)
scanNone: No block found in the UI
attrOff: Counting is disabled on this block by the custom-click-counter attribute
phantomMsg: This block exists only in the UI and not in the kernel (usually a temporary panel block), so counting was skipped
enableDesc: Double-click a countable block (e.g. "water: 1 time", "1/7") to count up. Single click still edits normally; hold Alt / Ctrl / Shift to double-click without counting.
stepDesc: How much to add per double-click (a negative value means double-click decreases).
patternDesc: One regex per line, with 3 capture groups: name / number / unit (unit may be empty). Defaults cover "water: 1 time", "water x3" and "1/7" (only the number before the slash changes, capped at the denominator). Takes effect immediately.
flashDesc: Flash the block when counted (blue for increase, red for decrease).
notifyDesc: Show a toast with the new value.
debugDesc: Print matching and update details to the console.
